parallel_current_main_observations.trajectory_nuisance_design: full 2x2x2 cross over N, executor and presentation for positive and hard-negative cases
parallel_current_main_observations.trajectory_process_scope: ZECP01 through ZECP18 are represented across the 13 trajectory families; process ids remain evaluator-only metadata
parallel_current_main_observations.trajectory_target_scope: structured candidate trajectory rule/emit/status with authority fixed to CANDIDATE_ONLY; it does not supervise an explicit implementation-class dispatch label
parallel_current_main_observations.packet_projection_parallel_lane: Current main also has a protocol packet projection generator with byte/derivability and split-surface guards; packet materialization is a different task from selecting the architecture boundary.

adjudication.complementary_question: Given a functional situation, which census process, implementation class, authority class and primary packet/boundary should own the next step?
why_distinct: Trajectory supervision can be correct while an evaluator still cannot tell SIMULATE_ON_GRID from STORE_IN_DB or DETERMINISTIC_BOUNDARY as an explicit classification task.

The current trajectory target intentionally keeps model output candidate-only even when its described path includes deterministic boundaries; that is correct for trajectory output but does not directly teach boundary ownership.

The current trajectory source does not use ZECP20 JSPACE_OBSERVATION_CONTROL_RESEARCH as a supervised process family; the boundary seed includes ZECP20 to separate observable Claude bridging from optional causal J-Space research.

branch_seed_limitations: Only 10 TRAIN candidate rows / 5 causal minimal-pair families exist in v1.
No validation or frozen holdout rows are committed in this v1 seed.
No full N/executor/presentation nuisance factorial is committed in this v1 seed.
ZECP19 CLAYCODE_COGNITIVE_TRANSFORM is not yet represented.
Process/class labels are supervised targets and therefore this seed alone cannot establish robust abstraction beyond the covered functional wording.

requirements_before_scale: Fuse rather than duplicate the current 104-row trajectory source.
Add validation and frozen holdout boundary-dispatch families with all five classes represented.
Cross or conditionally prove independence from N, executor identity and presentation nuisances.
Add ZECP19 and independently validate ZECP20/model-specific causal-research boundary semantics.
Derive process/class truth from exact bound census/ABI bytes in the evaluator rather than trusting row metadata.
Run the canonical candidate gate and leak/ancestry checks at exact-current source identity before any admission.

research_return.architecture: Keep process-boundary dispatch, cognitive trajectory generation, protocol-packet projection and opaque-code binding as factorized capabilities with separate metrics before joint composition.
research_return.harness: A future harness should report boundary-class accuracy separately from trajectory quality and packet-field correctness, then test whether boundary dispatch survives N/executor/presentation changes.
research_return.falsifier: If trajectory quality is high but explicit boundary dispatch fails under paraphrase or nuisance changes, the model has not learned the architecture boundary robustly.
